data.name: Torian
data.gender_notes: Torian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'torquere' meaning 'to turn', this name was given to a Roman soldier carrying a torch during a battle. In Christian symbolism, it can represent one who carries the light of faith. The name Torian carries the meaning “Torch bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Torian usually hope their child will grow to embody torch bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Torian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Torch bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Torian total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
